controlled_reproduction.setup: Two raw-wire peers request the same 128 verified blocks in opposite orders. Both queues must drain within five seconds.
controlled_reproduction.before: Fails with 0 pending reads, 4 finished reads, and all 2 writer command slots free.
controlled_reproduction.after: Passes, including ten consecutive repetitions. Read completions own their payload so cache eviction cannot lose an upload.

notes: Sequential release runs on the same dev machine; no filesystem cache dropping.
Both series include peer trace polling. The after runner adds a finished-read counter.
Total duration includes seed startup and durability; these are observations, not performance guarantees.
